notes: I rewrote the rule: the evidence shows only "LL" runs are removed (HELLO→HEO, HHELLO→HHEO keeps HH, HeLLO→HeO), while other doubled letters (AABB, AAAB) and non-doubled strings are untouched. The previous "delete all repeated characters in uppercase strings" rule was contradicted by E2's ABCABC/AABB/AAAB results.
